ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels (approximately 15%) to dominant low-intensity dark pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white circular ring structures (rosettes) distributed across both lobes; localized clusters of high-intensity white pixels on terminal lobe tips; small irregular white patch near the central notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 45 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box penetration.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes varying between 5-15 pixels along the right lobe trailing edge; left lobe edge appears moderately irregular but is partially obscured by spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward-outward sweep for both lobes, terminating in pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white-outlined constellations (5-15 pixel diameter) scattered across the ventral plane, characteristic of past barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned high-intensity linear streaks/scratches visible on the medial and distal sections of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the terminal tips and segments of the trailing edges; numerous healed circular rosette scars across the fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant jagged indentation/loss of tissue on the upper-middle section of the right lobe trailing edge.
